f: Meow's "A Love Letter to Wen Bros" was minted as an NFT and split into one trillion WEN: the first community coin based on a fractionalized NFT.
m: Every WEN is a share of one cultural object, not a number invented for a chart.

f: The poem was the first NFT ever minted on the Wen New Standard; at launch it was the only one.
m: WEN starts from the standard's very first asset.

f: WNS, proposed on January 25, 2024 by Ovols and Jupiter, keeps NFTs light: supply 1, decimals 0, metadata inside the mint, collections through group and member extensions.
m: Cheaper, simpler NFTs that anyone can build on.

f: wen_royalty_distribution (diste3n…) enforces royalty payouts for WNS assets through a Token-2022 transfer hook.
m: Creators are paid by the token itself on every transfer, not by promises.

f: The wen_new_standard program ID is wns1gDLt8fgLcGhWi5MqAqgXpwEP1JftKE9eZnXS1HM.
m: The standard is live code on Solana, not a whitepaper.

f: The Wen Program Library is open source under Apache-2.0, built with Anchor, with the wpl_cli tool and tests run by anchor test.
m: Anyone can read, run and reuse the code.

t: First token of Jupiter's LFG Launchpad
f: WEN launched on January 26, 2024 as the first project on Jupiter's LFG (Launch, Farm, Grow) Launchpad.
m: It opened the launch path later used by other projects.

t: Airdropped to over a million wallets
f: More than one million Solana wallets were eligible, and every eligible wallet received the same amount.
m: Wide, equal distribution from day one.

t: A real stress test for Solana
f: WEN was a deliberate stress test before the JUP airdrop: Phantom reported about 8,000 requests per second at the WEN peak and, with the lessons, about 90,000 at JUP.
m: Its launch made Solana's wallets and launch tools stronger.

f: After a three-day claim window, more than 271 billion unclaimed WEN, over 27% of supply, were burned on January 29, 2024.
m: A real supply cut, visible on-chain, not a promise.

f: The allocation was 70% airdrop, 20% liquidity pool and 10% treasury.
m: Most of the supply went straight to the community.

f: AssetDash minted its 10,000-piece Elements collection on WNS 18 days after WEN launched.
m: The standard was used for real collections within weeks.

f: WEN is the governance token of the Wen DAO.
m: Holders have a voice, not only a balance.

f: The Wen validator runs with 0% commission and no MEV fees and attracted close to 100,000 SOL in delegated stake.
m: It helps secure Solana and returns the rewards to stakers.

f: wenSOL, built with Sanctum, lets SOL be staked through a Wen validator while staying liquid.
m: Staking without locking your SOL away.

t: The mint is checked every week
f: An open GitHub Action reads the WEN mint on mainnet every week; it was green on November 11, 16 and 23, 2026.
m: Anyone can see the check and repeat it.

t: A verified chain from poem to token
f: Read on-chain at slot 468049071: poem NFT on WNS (Token-2022), then one trillion WEN on the original SPL Token with no fee and revoked authorities.
m: The whole path can be checked, link by link.

f: Free, tested models on WNS and Token-2022: receipts and warranty cards, royalties, B2B invoices, payments bridge, simulator, mint inspector; 41 tests, devnet first.
m: Ready patterns for shops and builders, open to copy.

f: Wen Counter, a receive-only till (57 checks); Wen Counter Pay for WooCommerce (59 checks); and the wen-counter-shop skill for AI assistants. No fee per sale.
m: Physical use: a shop can accept payments today, for free.

f: The Wen Foundation supports public goods on Solana; the Wen Almanac adds 576 source cards, a 270-question quiz and 278 image stories, every claim with a status in the trust chain.
m: Learning and checking are free for everyone.
